San Juan was founded by Spanish colonists in 1521 , who called it Ciudad de Puerto Rico ( `` Rich Port City '' ) . Puerto Rico 's capital is the second oldest European-established capital city in the Americas , after Santo Domingo , in the Dominican Republic .
